en:
Whoa, you scared me!
A-Are you here to kill me!?

Nee-heehee...you must have a lot of free time
if you're just wandering around, Shuichi.

Wow! Amazing, Shuichi!
I was just thinking about talking to you!
...But, you already know that's a lie.
Huh, you really wanna pick me!?

You must be a weirdo if you wanna choose
a liar like me.
Spend time together
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Kokichi?
Spend time together
Go on a date
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Kokichi?
...Oh, you're not?
Are you sure *you're* not the liar, Shuichi?

I bet even as we stand here talking, you're 
just waiting for me to drop my guard, huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time with Kokichi, resisting
the urge to contradict his absurdities.

People often say detectives need to run
around a lot for clues and stuff...

But hearing that makes me think detectives 
are even more incompetent.

If you actually were a talented detective, then
couldn't you find the culprit without evidence?

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time teaching Kokichi the
ins and outs of detective work.

I like lying to you since you make the most
hilarious reactions, Shuichi.

Lying is like breathing to me. It's not worth
lying to someone if they don't make a reaction.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time learning the
ins and outs of lying from Kokichi...

Do you want me to teach you how to get
good at lying?
Then leave it to me!

I'll turn you into an excellent liar
within an hour!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi spent a good amount of time
teaching me how to be a perfect liar...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and I grew a little closer today.
